note: NO explicit ball estimate exists: ball info is implicit in the camera CNN (depth + 6-frame RGB stack). The map shows TRUE ball (white) and the LAST CAMERA SIGHTING (cyan) — ball knowledge begins at first_ball_sighting_step, when the ball first enters the frustum (>~1.25 m; closer is the foot-zone blind spot). neck_pitch is policy-controlled/unlimited but the current policy only pitches ~-11 deg, so it rarely looks fully down at a close ball.
